The route data shows you were taken 8.8 km, slightly shorter than the best possible route (8.9 km), so there was no detour. The higher-than-usual fare came from the meter's time charge while traffic crawled in heavy rain, not from extra distance: the fare broke down exactly into the standard base, distance, time and platform amounts. You don't need to do anything, and no refund is due. Nothing was flagged on your account.

Your route was the shortest and most direct option — the trip covered 8.8 km versus a best-route estimate of 8.9 km — and the fare matched the meter components exactly, including the time charge during heavy rain. No refund is being issued and no action is being taken against your account. No off-route segment was recorded and no safety concern was raised. Thanks for the clear pickup messages; nothing further is needed from you.
